title: Forty-Seven Questions

pre.en: What is Mia's last question about?
pre.zh: Mia 最后一个问题问的是什么？
options: A man in an old photo
Why the Close button is green

intro: 新来的测试 Mia 第一天上班，带着一本子问题来找小陈。这是两个人的对话，读的时候留意 Mia 怎么说自己的打算：decide、plan、hope、need、manage 后面都接 to do。最后一个问题，连小陈也答不上来。

sentences.en: Morning!
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: You must be Mia.
I'm Chen. Rachel asked me to fill you in on the app.
sentences.zh: 我是小陈。Rachel 让我给你讲讲这个 App 的情况。

sentences.en: Hi! I've written down a few questions.
sentences.speaker: Mia

sentences.en: Well, forty-seven, actually.
I hope to get through them all today.
Forty-seven. Right.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Let me make a coffee first.
Sorry, I know it's a lot, but this job means a lot to me.
sentences.zh: 不好意思，我知道有点多，可这份工作对我真的很重要。
sentences.speaker: Mia

sentences.en: I've decided to learn Swift by Christmas.
sentences.zh: 我已经定了，圣诞节前要学会 Swift。

sentences.en: And I'm planning to read every old ticket in the bug tracker.
sentences.zh: 还打算把 bug 系统里的旧工单全读一遍。

sentences.en: Every ticket? Seriously?
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: There are about four thousand.
You don't need to read them all.
Too late. I started last night.
sentences.zh: 来不及了，我昨晚就开始读了。
sentences.speaker: Mia

sentences.en: And I've already managed to find three typos in the welcome email.
sentences.zh: 而且已经在欢迎邮件里挑出三个错别字了。

sentences.en: OK, calm down.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Nobody expects you to take responsibility for the whole app in your first week.
sentences.zh: 没人指望你第一周就把整个 App 扛起来。

sentences.en: Come on, I'll show you the ropes.
And feel free to ask me anything.
Great.
sentences.speaker: Mia

sentences.en: Question five: why is the "Close" button green?
sentences.zh: 第五个问题：为什么「关闭」按钮是绿色的？

sentences.en: Er... nobody knows.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Anyway, you'll get used to things like that.
sentences.zh: 反正这种事你慢慢就习惯了。

sentences.en: So, out of curiosity, why did you choose testing?
sentences.zh: 对了，我好奇问一句，你为什么选了做测试？

sentences.en: That's a good question.
sentences.speaker: Mia

sentences.en: Why did you choose iOS?
I asked first!
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Wait, is it four o'clock already?
Let's take a break.
You're getting the hang of it, aren't you?
sentences.zh: 你已经慢慢上手了，对吧？

sentences.en: I think so. I really enjoy finding mistakes.
sentences.zh: 应该是吧。我特别喜欢挑错。
sentences.speaker: Mia

sentences.en: Could I take on a few tickets tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 明天我能接几个工单吗？

sentences.en: Of course. Any more questions?
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Just one.
sentences.speaker: Mia

sentences.en: Who's the man in the old photo by the kitchen?
sentences.zh: 茶水间旁边那张老照片上的男人是谁？

sentences.en: I've worked here for two years, and I have no idea.
sentences.zh: 我在这儿干了两年了，完全不知道。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: OK. I'll find out by Friday.
sentences.speaker: Mia

sentences.en: Good luck with that.
sentences.speaker: Chen

cards.zh: 给某人讲讲情况；补上信息
cards.note: to tell someone the details of something they do not know yet
cards.tip: 人放在 fill 和 in 中间：fill me in；讲的内容用 on：fill sb in on the project。
cards.example: I missed the meeting — can you fill me in?

cards.zh: 好吧；行（表示听到了、接受了）
cards.note: 单独一个 Right. 不是「对」，是「好吧，知道了」，语气平平，常带点无奈。
to be very important to someone
IT 工作里指系统里的一条任务或问题；平时是「票」：a train ticket。
记录、分配和跟进 bug 的工具，比如 Jira。track 是「跟踪」。
typing error 的简称；make a typo 打错字。
新人入职或新用户注册时收到的第一封邮件。
to stop feeling upset, angry or nervous
expect sb to do 指望某人做某事；也有「预计」的意思：I expect it'll rain。
to accept that something is your job or your fault
cards.tip: for 后面接负责的事；这里 Chen 用来安慰新人：还轮不到你扛。
cards.example: As team lead, I take responsibility for the delay.

cards.zh: 教某人入门；带某人熟悉门道
cards.note: to teach someone how to do a job or how things work in a new place
cards.tip: ropes 总是复数；自己「摸清门道」说 learn the ropes。只用在新人身上，不能说 show sb the rope。
cards.example: Sam will show you the ropes on your first day.

cards.note: used to tell someone that they can do something if they want to
cards.tip: 常用祈使句，客气又热情；后面接 to do：feel free to ask，不说 feel free asking。
cards.example: Feel free to call me if you have any problems.

cards.note: to become familiar with something new so that it no longer feels strange
because you want to know something, not for any special reason
cards.tip: 问私人一点的问题前加一句，显得没有恶意；常说 just out of curiosity。
cards.example: Just out of curiosity, how much did your new laptop cost?

cards.zh: 问得好（常用来争取时间或回避）
cards.note: something you say when you need time to think, or when you do not know the answer
cards.tip: 不一定是夸对方，很多时候意思是「这个我也答不上来」。语气要靠上下文听。
cards.example: "When will it be ready?" "That's a good question."

cards.note: to stop working or doing something for a short time
cards.tip: a 不能丢：take a break；歇多久放后面：take a ten-minute break。
cards.example: Let's take a ten-minute break and come back at three.

cards.note: to learn how to do something, especially after some practice
cards.tip: 最常见的是 get the hang of it；hang 在这里没有「挂」的意思，整块记。
cards.example: Driving on the left is strange at first, but you'll get the hang of it.

cards.note: to accept a job or a responsibility
cards.tip: 主动要活儿干就说 take on sth；代词放中间：take it on。
cards.example: Don't take on more work than you can finish this sprint.

cards.note: to not know something at all
to get information about something, often by asking someone or by chance
